Needs changes before merge. Safety-tier review: this PR changes Deburr toolpaths.

Requested before merge:

1. **Invalidate legacy caches for chain-selected Deburr operations.** `crates/app/src/operation/params/mill3d.rs:205` preserves the old stamp when the new filters have their default values. However, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:1237` changes the meaning of an existing chain selection. I disabled picked-edge forwarding to reproduce the former generator. I saved a chain-selected operation, restored the generator, and opened the file. The operation remained `OpStatus::Ok`. Its cached path broke all four top edges; regeneration broke only the selected edge. Add a stamp version for this changed selection behavior, or invalidate these caches during loading. Add a test that opens a legacy cache and requires regeneration before posting.
2. **Include the referenced exclusion models in the stamp.** `crates/app/src/operation/params/mill3d.rs:216` writes only the model name and chain ID. Generation also reads the model's existence, geometry, and placement through `deburr_picks::chains_of`. I generated an operation with an exclusion on a second model, then deleted that model. Regeneration refused the missing reference, but the cached operation still reported `OpStatus::Ok`. Include each referenced model's geometry and setup-frame placement in the stamp. An unresolved reference must make the cache stale. Add tests for moving, changing, and deleting an exclusion model.
3. **Add before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/deburr_page.rs:25` adds visible controls, but the body has no screenshots. Show the Deburr Geometry tab before and after the change. Include the enabled hole-filter fields and the excluded-edge list. Store screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

Local validation:

- The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`370d38df63bbb7fcacc142f524fcf64c095b5ed2`) was clean. That commit is already an ancestor of the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 291 steps, 290 passed, one environment failure. Motion: 589 tests passed. App: 2,222 tests passed. UI: 1,303 tests passed, one failed. The gate took 33.1 minutes.
- The UI failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. The local machine supplied no graphics adapter. An exact local rerun failed for the same reason. This is an environment limitation, not a requested code change:

  ```text
  egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
  metal found no adapters
  ```

- The seven motion filter tests, eight app filter tests, MCP Deburr test, and existing Deburr alignment tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- No CL or NC goldens changed. No snapshot PNG changed.

Independent mutation checks:

| Mutation | Test | Disabled | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| Do not forward picked chains from the app | `a_picked_edge_is_the_only_edge_broken` | FAIL | PASS |
| Disable the minimum-angle comparison | `a_crease_below_the_minimum_edge_angle_is_skipped_out_loud` | FAIL | PASS |

After restoration, all eight app filter tests and all seven motion filter tests passed. Two temporary cache tests reproduced findings 1 and 2: each expected `Stale` but received `Ok`. All temporary source and test changes were restored. No review evidence was committed or pushed. No GitHub runner was used.

The new fields use the existing commands, project DTO, and MCP tools. The tests cover the main filter behavior. The remaining cache defects prevent a clean safety review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Legacy chain-selected Deburr caches now require regeneration. `a_legacy_chain_selected_cache_requires_regeneration_before_posting` opens the old cache and verifies posting refusal, regeneration, and successful posting. `an_automatic_legacy_deburr_cache_keeps_its_stamp` verifies compatibility.
2. Exclusion references now stamp resolved geometry and setup-frame placement. Missing references make the cache stale. Pins: `moving_an_exclusion_model_stales_the_deburr_cache`, `changing_an_exclusion_model_stales_the_deburr_cache`, and `deleting_an_exclusion_model_stales_the_deburr_cache`. Each verifies posting refusal after the change.
3. The PR body now links the [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ff2cec170d626b09167f6616843f5e3c575ca765/2688/deburr-geometry-before.png) and [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ff2cec170d626b09167f6616843f5e3c575ca765/2688/deburr-geometry-after.png) captures. The after capture shows enabled hole fields and the excluded-edge list. Actual UI meshes and textures use CPU rendering. Images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

All four cache mutations failed with the fix disabled and passed after restoration. All five new cache tests and eight existing filter tests pass.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED, 291 of 292 steps passed. Only `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` failed: `metal found no adapters`. This matches the review's environment limitation. Motion: 589 passed. App: 2,227 passed. UI: 1,303 passed.

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.

New head: `45ba2293b47304ac09ecde0cbfbb0a88df735524`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

Conflicts with current main. The three findings from the previous review are resolved.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes Deburr toolpaths.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:1174`: the Deburr fields conflict with main's new `unreachable` policy. The latest local trial merge failed in 17 files. At merge time, preserve both sets of parameters and their safety rules. Review the resolutions and run the affected gates again. I did not resolve these conflicts.

The conflicting main is `409c0b5abf6eb561a49349b31f83784f86b853d8`. The files are:

```text
crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs
crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs
crates/app/src/operation/params/mill3d.rs
crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs
crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs
crates/app/src/project/params.rs
crates/app/src/project/params_impl.rs
crates/app/tests/deburr_links.rs
crates/app/tests/edge_break_gate.rs
crates/app/tests/operations.rs
crates/app/tests/setup_align_deburr.rs
crates/app/tests/stock_deburr_part.rs
crates/motion/src/finishing3d/deburr.rs
crates/motion/src/finishing3d/mod.rs
crates/motion/tests/deburr.rs
crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs
crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs
```

The earlier findings are met:

- Chain-selected legacy caches now require regeneration before posting. The test also checks successful posting after regeneration. Automatic legacy caches keep their stamp.
- Exclusion models now contribute geometry and setup-frame placement to the stamp. Movement, geometry changes, and deletion make the cache stale. Undo restores the valid cache. The tests check posting refusal.
- The body has before and after screenshots. I inspected both images. The after image shows the enabled hole fields and the excluded-edge list. No screenshot is in the PR diff.

Local validation:

The first trial merge with main `c414608701df4317220b8078b727dd2d56a52b14` succeeded. Main advanced during validation. These results apply to that successful trial merge:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Three touched crates, `cargo test --no-run` | PASS; 19 min 26 s |
| Motion library | 443 passed; 10 ignored |
| Motion `deburr`, `deburr_filters` | 16 passed |
| App library | 380 passed; 1 ignored |
| App selected suites and Deburr seed | 104 passed |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 1,232 passed; 1 environment failure; 7 ignored |
| Three touched crates, clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | PASS |

The selected app suites were `deburr_cache_stamp`, `deburr_edge_filters`, `deburr_links`, `edge_break_gate`, `mcp_deburr`, `project_roundtrip`, `setup_align_deburr`, and `stock_deburr_part`.

The UI failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. An exact local rerun failed for the same reason:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
metal found no adapters
```

This is the same environment limitation as the previous review. It is not a requested code change.

After the latest merge failed, I aborted it and checked the unchanged PR head separately:

- The three-crate `cargo test --no-run` passed in 1 min 52 s.
- All 30 tests passed in `deburr_cache_stamp`, `deburr_edge_filters`, `mcp_deburr`, `deburr`, and `deburr_filters`.
- Clippy passed for all targets in the three touched crates, with `-D warnings`.

Independent mutations on the successful trial merge:

| Mutation | Pin | Disabled | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| Remove the legacy-selection stamp | `a_legacy_chain_selected_cache_requires_regeneration_before_posting` | FAIL | PASS |
| Omit exclusion geometry from the stamp | `changing_an_exclusion_model_stales_the_deburr_cache` | FAIL | PASS |

Both mutations returned `Ok` where the test required `Stale`. After restoration, all five cache tests passed. All temporary source changes were restored.

No CL or NC golden changed. No snapshot PNG changed. I used no GitHub runner. I committed and pushed no code or review evidence. The latest merge cannot be built until its conflicts are resolved. The PR remains a draft with the `conflicts` verdict.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Merged `upstream/main` (`75e74a9cbd8d79b36651a8e77cf41fa8c429b402`) to resolve the 17 conflicting files. Both Deburr parameter sets remain. The resolution preserves the filters, unreachable-edge policy, stamp inputs, project fields, UI controls, and safety checks. Independent inspection found no lost checks.

Pins:
- `active_edge_filters_preserve_the_unreachable_refusal` checks that active filters preserve the refusal and skip policies.
- `the_filters_round_trip_the_project_file` now checks that nondefault filters and `Refuse` survive project loading.

Both pins passed. Disabling the refusal guard made the motion pin fail. Reading the policy as `SkipWithNote` made the roundtrip pin fail. Both passed after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED, 297 of 298 steps passed. Only `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` failed: `no graphics adapter`; `metal found no adapters`. This matches the review's environment limitation. All motion, app, and other UI steps passed.

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.

New head: `b1fd2540f1879e21e941a6fd6e1460f76f6b0adf`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft. Labels remain unchanged.

Clean review. No blocking findings. This feature is ready for the maintainer at the next cut.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes Deburr toolpaths.

The earlier findings are resolved:

- Legacy chain-selected caches require regeneration before posting. Automatic legacy caches keep their stamp.
- Exclusion models contribute geometry and setup-frame placement to the stamp. Movement, geometry changes, and deletion make the cache stale. The tests check posting refusal and undo.
- The body links before and after screenshots. I inspected both. The after image shows the enabled hole fields and the excluded-edge list.
- The conflict resolution keeps both Deburr parameter sets. It preserves the stamp inputs, project fields, UI controls, and unreachable-edge refusal. Both combined-behavior pins pass.

Local validation:

The final trial merge with `upstream/main` (`163bab9b0614f56db86741cefb0cf4659fa625dc`) succeeded without a conflict. Main advanced during the review, so I repeated the integration and library tests on this merge.

| Check on the final trial merge | Result |
|---|---|
| App selected integration suites | 109 passed |
| Motion `deburr`, `deburr_filters`, `deburr_unreachable` | 22 passed |
| App `operations`, Deburr tests | 5 passed |
| App library | 380 passed; 1 ignored |
| Motion library | 447 passed; 10 ignored |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 1,232 passed; 1 environment failure; 7 ignored |
| Three touched crates, clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | PASS |

The app integration suites were `deburr_cache_stamp`, `deburr_edge_filters`, `deburr_links`, `deburr_unreachable`, `edge_break_gate`, `mcp_deburr`, `project_roundtrip`, `setup_align_deburr`, and `stock_deburr_part`.

The initial three-crate `cargo test --no-run` passed in 42 min 18 s against main `75e74a9cbd8d79b36651a8e77cf41fa8c429b402`. The final integration run rebuilt the affected targets successfully. Clippy passed with the shared cache disabled.

The UI failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. An exact rerun on the final merge failed for the same reason:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
metal found no adapters
```

This matches the previous reviews. It is an environment limitation, not a requested code change.

Independent mutations on the final trial merge:

| Guard disabled | Test | Disabled | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum edge angle | `a_crease_below_the_minimum_edge_angle_is_skipped_out_loud` | FAIL | PASS |
| Hole filter | `a_hole_rim_inside_the_diameter_range_is_skipped` | FAIL | PASS |

Both failures reached the expected assertions. After restoration, all seven motion filter tests passed. No temporary source change remains.

No CL or NC golden changed in this PR. No snapshot PNG changed. No screenshot or review evidence was committed. I used no GitHub runner. Manual UI interaction and the release tier were not exercised.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME. The reviewed head is the merged head, `b1fd2540f1879e21e941a6fd6e1460f76f6b0adf`. No commit came after it.

This merge relies on the safety-tier review by mkinney's review agent of 07:38 UTC on that head. The PR is a `feat` for #1888 (P4) and touches no P1, so no second review is necessary. A reviewed `feat` merges now and ships at the next cut.
